classification: Two reviewed analytic compatibility and stability theorems; original all-orders convergence remains OPEN
conclusions: For the literal full signing K, trace-optimal diagonal majorizer D, q=N-1, S=tr(D), eta=S/(N sqrt(q)) and canonical gap gamma=(S-tr(|K|^3)/q)/S, the diagonal spread obeys delta=S tr(D^-1)/N^2-1 <=4 eta^2 gamma.
Actual original and weighted internal/cross scores differ by explicit O(N sqrt(delta)) bounds without replacing K by a false scalar-normalized contraction.
In an actual original p=q=0 refined cell, the actual positive comparison field and its pure-cross field have expected nonaugmented maximum difference at most 2 sqrt(kappa log(2)) N^(3/2) delta^(1/4).

For arbitrary feasible D, conjugated actual PSD-field trace differs in nuclear norm by at most E_delta=(w N^2/2) sqrt(delta)(1+sqrt(1+delta)); this controls both metric traces uniformly on fixed |metric eta|<=1-b0.

For 0<=delta<=1, the natural D-metric upper differs from the explicitly numerical flattened reference by at most 3 sqrt(w) N^(3/2) delta^(1/4)/sqrt(1-|metric eta|). The same actual weighted contraction, drift and coupled cell are retained.
